hypothesis: Diversified time-series momentum across EURUSD and XAUUSD captures slow under-reaction and crisis trends; inverse-volatility sizing reduces concentration.
evidence_basis: Moskowitz, Ooi, Pedersen (2012), Time Series Momentum
Hurst, Ooi, Pedersen (2017), A Century of Evidence on Trend-Following Investing

data.execution_proxy: next daily close-to-close return; one-day lag
data.limitation: two markets are a pilot, not the broad diversified portfolio in the literature

models.ensemble: sign of the mean of four lookback signs
models.rebalance: daily only when desired sign changes

splits.holdout_policy: sealed until one model is selected from validation and OOS

costs.oracle_fee: assumed refunded on successful full close; failures excluded

live_policy: never; requires live rollover capture, Ostium execution parity, paper and explicit authorization
